# G05 — Post-process and resilience graph

**Goal:** Define bounded render DAG; prototype local blur/bloom, heatfield kernels/decay, trail feedback reset and degraded-mode/device-loss policies. Test cold-idle, bounded blur halo/temporal buffers, reduced motion and synthetic heat only. E06/E09/E11/E12.

**Write-set exclusive:** `docs/agent-results/blobin-next-01/G05.md` and `experiments/blobin-next-01/G05/**`. The latter is an original private lab, **not blob.in production source**. Do not edit other workers, shared shader code, historical blob.in snapshot, Gnosix or the in.gnu6 engine.

**Gate:** define a minimal adversarial input and reproducible outcome. Record exact source+toolchain, dependency lock, viewport/DPR, hardware when relevant, verification results and a clear unsupported/NOT_RUN path. No invented benchmark or GPU proof. CPU compatibility and identity ownership must be addressed even for GPU-specific work.

**Handoff:** original committed lab code if implemented + one evidence report; declare candidate shared interfaces as proposals; integrator reconciles after all workers finish.
